children: Constellation Acquisition Corp I disclosed a Water Tower Research transcript where US Elemental’s incoming CEO outlined McDermitt’s 21.5M t LCE resource, planned Nasdaq listing and near-term financing and feasibility milestones.
Filed transcript of Water Tower Research discussion about the proposed business combination and PubCo’s anticipated Nasdaq listing.
McDermitt: 21.5M tonnes LCE near-surface resource, PFS shows ~ $3B+ NPV and ~18% IRR, 63-year project life (based on 15% resource).
US Elemental intends to list on Nasdaq (ULIT) after S-4 effectiveness and pursue $20M–$30M financing to fund infill drilling and feasibility.
Project uses conventional beneficiation + hydrometallurgy; beneficiation and magnesium byproduct pathways could materially improve economics.
McDermitt is in FAST-41 and has a DOE cooperative R&D agreement; permitting acceleration and potential future federal funding are being pursued.
